question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the mandatory 'continuing interest' requirement for the Sponsor/Manager of a Category II AIF is the LOWER of:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the continuing interest of the Sponsor/Manager for Category I and Category II AIFs is not less than 2.5% of the corpus OR INR 5 crore, whichever is lower. This is the mandatory minimum 'skin-in-the-game' requirement. The Trap: Option A is the Category III threshold (5% or INR 10 crore, whichever is lower). Options C and D are fabricated numbers. Note: Sponsor/Manager continuing interest must be retained on an unencumbered basis and cannot be through waiver of management fees.
